svg.title: A polished service plaque hangs above an empty pump plinth.
svg.desc: A pristine blank plaque celebrates the space where a pump should stand. Riju's account trail ends at the absence, Ila looks from plaque to drain, and a functioning camera watches the failed works.
svg.text: Page 31, panel 3 · Medium shot on a polished plaque above the absent pump

text.tspan: The ceremonial claim and the accounting record agree
perfectly with each other and not with the site.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
